evidence: Home page lists 8 job cards (job-1 to job-8) with "Showing 8 jobs" text, browsable without login.
Each job card shows title (e.g. "Senior Frontend Developer"), company, location (San Francisco, CA), salary range ($140k - $180k), date, type, and skill tags.
Industry filter (Technology → 2 jobs), Location filter (New York, NY → 1 job), Job Type filter (Part-time → 1 job) all correctly filtered the results.
Typing "Python" in the search box filtered results to the Data Analyst job (which has Python as a skill tag), showing "Showing 1 jobs".
Job list updated instantly with each filter selection and each keystroke in the search box, without page reload.
Job details page for job-5 shows full description, "What you'll do" list, "Requirements" list, and "Required Skills" tags (SQL, Python, Tableau, Statistics).

Submitting empty form kept form on page and focused the required Full Name field (no submission). Submitting with invalid email "not-an-email" also blocked submission and focused the Email field. Only after correcting the email did submission succeed.

Filled Full Name, Email, Cover Letter/Message fields on job-5 details page and clicked Submit Application; got success toast "Application submitted! Your application for Data Analyst at FinanceFirst has been sent."
Application submission returned immediate success confirmation toast without errors.

actual: Submitted a second application to the same job (job-5) using the identical email address (test.user@example.com) as a prior successful application. The system accepted it and displayed the same success toast "Application submitted!" with no warning or rejection of the duplicate.

evidence: Submitting the Post Job form with all fields empty did not create a listing; native browser validation messages "Please fill out this field." appeared on Job Title, Min Salary, Max Salary, and Job Description fields, blocking submission.

Filled Job Title "QA Automation Engineer", Industry "Engineering", Employment Type "Full-time", Location "Remote", salary range 90000-120000, description, and skill "Selenium"; clicked Post Job. Got success toast "Job posted successfully! Your job listing is now live and visible to job seekers." and was redirected to employer dashboard where the new job appears.

Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists posted jobs with title, industry, type, location, salary, and post date, including the newly created "QA Automation Engineer" listing. Stats show "6 Active Jobs".
Clicking the applications count button (2) on "Senior Frontend Developer" expanded an "Applications (2)" panel listing each applicant.

Applications panel clearly separates two distinct applicants: "Alex Johnson" (alex.j@email.com, 555-0101, applied Jan 20, with his message) and "Maria Garcia" (maria.g@email.com, 555-0102, applied Jan 22, with her message), each in its own card.

issue: Missing edit functionality for job listings
actual: On the Employer Dashboard, each job listing card only has two controls: an applications-count toggle and a delete (trash) icon. Delete works correctly (confirmed via confirmation dialog and job removed from list, Active Jobs count decremented from 6 to 5). However, there is no edit/update button or link anywhere on the job card, and clicking the job title does not navigate to an edit page. Employers cannot edit a published job listing's details.

issue: No access control preventing job seekers from posting jobs
actual: The application has no login/authentication system distinguishing employers from job seekers. The "Post a Job" link and /employer/post-job page are freely accessible in the main navigation to any visitor without any sign-in or role verification, and a job posting was successfully created earlier without any employer credentials. Any job seeker can post a job opening.
